title: China's Rainbow Mountains, ¥74 — But the Wrong Hour Ruins Them | China Travel Expert
description:
Travel all the way to China's Rainbow Mountains and they can look... grey. Zhangye Danxia is one of the cheapest world-class landforms on earth — about ¥74 (~$10) at the gate, including the mandatory shuttle — but the striped red-gold-green rock only glows when the light is right.

At midday the flat sun washes the colors out. They blaze at sunrise and late afternoon, and the hues peak in the June–October window, especially just after rain. Pick the wrong hour and you drove a long way for dull hills.

🧭 Expert Tip: don't leave on the early shuttle — stay for the last one. The 5–7 pm light is the payoff that most day-trippers miss.

七彩丹霞只要约74元,但来错时辰就是一片灰——日出和傍晚才出片。
